description:
The pinnacle of BMX race performance. The Quartz Carbonic Pro is built around our six-time World Championship-winning ultra-lightweight alloy frame, combining championship-proven pedigree with a no-compromise specification package. Equipped with only our finest components, this is our ultimate Pro-level race bike, engineered for riders chasing every advantage on the track.
Featuring our Solar Carbon fork, Solar Pro Carbon rims, Tioga Fastr tires, Arise Echo hubs, and our latest hydraulic disc brake system, every component has been carefully selected to maximise speed, stiffness, and control. The result is a race machine designed to perform at the highest level, whether you're battling for podium positions or competing on the world stage.
Now featuring the all-new Quartz Disc frame with our Sliding Disc Dropout System, flat-mount brake compatibility, and sleek internal cable routing, the Quartz Carbonic Pro represents the next evolution of championship-winning BMX race technology.

FRAME: RADIO RACELINE "QUARTZ DISC" frame, lightweight hydroformed 6061-T6 alloy, tapered headtube, sliding forged dropouts, with int. chaintensioners, flatmount disc brake

FORK: ARISE "SOLAR" carbon fork, 1-1/8" - 1.5" tapered steerer, 32mm offset, inc. 10mm adaptors

STEM: ARISE "NEON PRO" toploader stem, ext. 53mm, cold forged/cnc alloy

components.description: RADIO RACELINE "BSA24" bb set, external bearing cups, cnc machined, sealed
ARISE "XENON" hydraulic disc brake, 120mm rotor, rear, flatmount
ARISE "ARGON" 2pc crank, cold forged/cnc, alloy, 175mm length, 24mm spindle
ARISE "SOLAR" carbon fork, 1-1/8" - 1.5" tapered steerer, 32mm offset, inc. 10mm adaptors
RADIO RACELINE "XENON" grips, diamond knurling, clamp on grip, 139mm length
RADIO RACELINE "NEON PRO 7.5" hydroformed bar, multiple butted & heattreated crmo
RADIO RACELINE "PRO" integrated headset, sealed, threadless, 1-1/8" - 1.5"
ARISE "ECHO" front hub, alloy cnc, fully sealed, 36h, 3/8" female crmo axle
ARISE "ECHO" rear hub, alloy cnc, fully sealed, 36h, disc brake cassette, 15mm thru axle
ARISE "HELIUM PRO" seat clamp, quick-release, alloy
ARISE "NEON PRO" toploader stem, ext. 53mm, cold forged/cnc alloy
TIOGA "FASTR" tires, front: 20" x 1.75" and rear: 20" x 1.6"
